definitions.explanation: The organ in a woman's lower abdomen in which a baby develops before birth. The standard medical and everyday word.

examples.japanese: {子宮|しきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{子宮|しきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{育|そだ}つ→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧。
examples.english: A baby grows inside the womb.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二十歳|はたち}→二十歳：02933_hatachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎたら→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧、⟦{定期的|ていきてき}→定期的：06173_teikiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{子宮|しきゅう}がん⟦{検診|けんしん}→検診：07679_kenshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{勧|すす}められている→勧める：02120_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: Women over twenty are advised to have regular cervical cancer screenings.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {子宮|しきゅう}がん: uterine cancer; in screening contexts usually cervical cancer ({子宮頸|しきゅうけい}がん)
- {子宮筋腫|しきゅうきんしゅ}: uterine fibroids
- {子宮内膜|しきゅうないまく}: the lining of the uterus

WATCH OUT:
しきゅう has several common homophones: ⟦{至急|しきゅう}→至急：03679_shikyuu⟧ (urgently), ⟦{支給|しきゅう}→支給：02835_shikyuu⟧ (provision, payment), ⟦{四球|しきゅう}→四球：31080_shikyuu⟧ (a walk in baseball).
